discussion.body: Nym Hale. Main-side. Queen's Cove. Machinist-gunner. Treats a firearm as a dock tool, not a romance. Joins Act 4 when the party needs the airship frame to be a fact. Death crisis: dock fire, Act 4, if salvage is chosen over the pump. Default lives. Contingency: notes plus Cove shipwrights finish the airship for Act 7 approach. If dead, no personal Cove scenes; vehicle still exists. Not a third romance.
